title.narrative: for design and implementation of a comprehensive monitoring and evaluation system and wellness

description.narrative: México Evalúa is a nonpartisan organization that provides citizens with analysis and evaluation of Mexico's public policies and spending. México Evalúa focuses on seven key issues that impact Mexicans’ daily lives: justice, security, public spending, judicial transparency, economic regulation, education, and anticorruption. It tailors its analysis and policy recommendations to inform the advocacy campaigns of grassroots groups, including a network of organizations of patients with nontransmissible chronic illness comprised of individuals who have been denied medical treatments due to health sector irregularities. This organizational effectiveness grant will allow Mexico Evalúa to design and implement a comprehensive monitoring and evaluation system. There is also an allocation in this grant for wellness in furtherance of the organization’s charitable purpose.
